title: Voltage Keepsake
statementMd:
You have $*n*$ devices that you want to use simultaneously.

The $*i*$-th device uses $*a*_{*i*}$ units of power per second. This usage is continuous. That is, in $λ$ seconds, the device will use $λ·*a*_{*i*}$ units of power. The $*i*$-th device currently has $*b*_{*i*}$ units of power stored. All devices can store an arbitrary amount of power.

You have a single charger that can plug to any single device. The charger will add $*p*$ units of power per second to a device. This charging is continuous. That is, if you plug in a device for $λ$ seconds, it will gain $λ·*p*$ units of power. You can switch which device is charging at any arbitrary unit of time (including real numbers), and the time it takes to switch is negligible.

You are wondering, what is the maximum amount of time you can use the devices until one of them hits $0$ units of power.

If you can use the devices indefinitely, print `-1`. Otherwise, print the maximum amount of time before any one device hits $0$ power.

## Input

The first line contains two integers, $*n*$ and $*p*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$, $1 ≤ *p* ≤ 10^{9}$) — the number of devices and the power of the charger.

This is followed by $*n*$ lines which contain two integers each. Line $*i*$ contains the integers $*a*_{*i*}$ and $*b*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ 100 000$) — the power of the device and the amount of power stored in the device in the beginning.

## Output

If you can use the devices indefinitely, print `-1`. Otherwise, print the maximum amount of time before any one device hits $0$ power.

Your answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed $10^{ - 4}$.

Namely, let's assume that your answer is $*a*$ and the answer of the jury is $*b*$. The checker program will consider your answer correct if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/49eb236611e23b2e7c8e81e9516771daca716eec.png).

## Note

In sample test 1, you can charge the first device for the entire time until it hits zero power. The second device has enough power to last this time without being charged.

In sample test 2, you can use the device indefinitely.

In sample test 3, we can charge the third device for $2 / 5$ of a second, then switch to charge the second device for a $1 / 10$ of a second.
statementZhMd:
你有 $*n*$ 个希望同时使用的设备。

第 $*i*$ 个设备每秒消耗 $*a*_{*i*}$ 单位的电量。这种消耗是连续的。也就是说，在 $λ$ 秒内，该设备将消耗 $λ·*a*_{*i*}$ 单位的电量。第 $*i*$ 个设备当前存储了 $*b*_{*i*}$ 单位的电量。所有设备都可以存储任意多的电量。

你有一个充电器，可以将其连接到任意一个设备上。充电器每秒向设备充入 $*p*$ 单位的电量。这种充电也是连续的。也就是说，如果将设备连接充电 $λ$ 秒，它将获得 $λ·*p*$ 单位的电量。你可以在任意时刻（包括实数时刻）切换正在充电的设备，切换所需时间可以忽略不计。

你想知道，在其中一个设备的电量降至 $0$ 之前，最多可以使用这些设备多长时间。

如果可以无限期地使用这些设备，请输出 `-1`。否则，请输出在任意一个设备的电量降至 $0$ 之前所能持续的最长时间。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*p*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$，$1 ≤ *p* ≤ 10^{9}$）——设备的数量以及充电器的功率。

接下来 $*n*$ 行，每行包含两个整数。第 $*i*$ 行包含整数 $*a*_{*i*}$ 和 $*b*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ 100 000$）——设备的功耗以及设备初始存储的电量。

## 输出格式

如果可以无限期地使用这些设备，请输出 `-1`。否则，请输出在任意一个设备的电量降至 $0$ 之前所能持续的最长时间。

如果你的答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 4}$，则会被判定为正确。

具体来说，假设你的答案为 $*a*$，标准答案为 $*b*$。评测程序将在 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/49eb236611e23b2e7c8e81e9516771daca716eec.png) 时判定你的答案正确。

## 说明

在样例 1 中，你可以为第一个设备充电，直到它的电量耗尽。第二个设备的电量足够支撑这段时间，无需充电。

在样例 2 中，你可以无限期地使用该设备。

在样例 3 中，我们可以先为第三个设备充电 $2 / 5$ 秒，然后切换到第二个设备并为其充电 $1 / 10$ 秒。
